_comment: KLD-129. Per card: en/de Wikipedia titles (de null = interlanguage link of the en article) and the chosen Commons file (absent = the article's lead image if free; "" = no image). author overrides an unhelpful Commons Artist field. _check: what to look for when choosing (not read by the tool). Not fetched yet: run --candidates first, pin a file per card (the exact model, else the nearest generation, with a note), then: python3 -I klunki/tool/fetch_card_media.py motorcycles

A1.name: Ducati Panigale V4 S
A1._check: Panigale V4 / V4 S, 2025 generation if free, else the 2018-2024 V4

A2.name: BMW M 1000 RR
A2._check: an M 1000 RR (winglets, M colours), not a plain S 1000 RR

A4.name: Kawasaki Ninja H2R
A4._check: the H2R (track bike, no mirrors or lights); the road H2 only as the nearest model, with a note

B1.name: KTM 1390 Super Duke R Evo
B1._check: 1390 Super Duke R (2024-); else the 1290 with a note

C1.name: BMW R 1300 GS
C1._check: R 1300 GS (2023-), not the R 1250 GS

D1.name: Harley-Davidson Fat Boy 117
D1._check: Milwaukee-Eight Softail Fat Boy (2018-), not the 1990 Evo

D2.name: Indian Chief Dark Horse
D2._check: the 2022- Chief (steel frame, round tank); the 1940s Chief only as a last resort

E2.name: Honda CB750 Four
E2._check: a 1969-1970s CB750 Four (K0-K2), not a later DOHC

E4.name: Vincent Black Shadow
E4._check: a Series B or C Black Shadow

F1.name: Husqvarna 701 Enduro
F1._check: 701 Enduro (not the Supermoto); doubtful on Commons

F2.name: Suzuki DR-Z4S
F2._check: DR-Z4S (2025-); else the DR-Z400S as the predecessor, with a note

F3.name: Beta Alp 4.0
F3._check: probably no article; a free Alp 4.0 photo on Commons, else no photo ("")

F4.name: Yamaha WR125R
F4._check: WR125R, the 2026 model if free, else the 2009-2016 one with a note

G1.name: Vespa GTS 310
G1._check: a modern GTS (300 or 310); not a classic Vespa

G2.name: Honda Super Cub C125
G2._check: the C125 (2018-), not the lead image's classic Cub if that is older

G4.name: Kymco AK 575 Premium
G4._check: AK 575 (2025-); else the AK 550 with a note

H1.name: Zero SR/F
H1._check: an SR/F, not the company's lead image or logo

H2.name: Can-Am Pulse
H2._check: probably no article; a free Pulse photo on Commons, else no photo ("")

H3.name: LiveWire One
H3._check: LiveWire One or the 2019 Harley-Davidson LiveWire (the same bike)

H4.name: Kawasaki Ninja e-1
H4._check: Ninja e-1 (2024-), not the Z e-1
